name: dsh-top100
description: Verified DeepSeek Harness plugin rankings with daily GitHub updates

scripts.check: npm run search:build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.update:once: npm run collect && npm run db:sync
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dsh-top100/collector && npm run test -w @dsheval/dsh-top100-plugin && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dsh-top100/collector && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-top100/schema && npm run typecheck -w @dsheval/dsh-top100-plugin
scripts.plugin:check: npm run typecheck -w @dsheval/dsh-top100-plugin && npm run test -w @dsheval/dsh-top100-plugin
